Essential Knowledge

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about planning your Jawai Leopard Safari.

The safari cost is fixed at ₹3,500 per person / slot. We run two daily expeditions: the Early Morning Safari from 05:00 AM to 08:00 AM and the Evening Sunset Safari from 04:30 PM to 07:30 PM.
Jawai has one of the highest leopard densities in the world with over 60 resident leopards. Because leopards live in open granite boulders rather than thick jungle foliage, sighting success rates exceed 90% across 2–3 safaris.
You can click the "Book Safari" button to submit your request or click the WhatsApp button to chat directly with our reservation desk at +91 83560 30899 for instant slot confirmation.
Yes, highly safe. Our 4x4 Gypsies are driven by seasoned local drivers and accompanied by certified Rabari trackers who know the terrain intimately. Leopards in Jawai have peacefully coexisted with humans for generations.
